issues.description: The problem statement and example usage expect a static method named 'acceptSupplyDelivery(String, int, int)', but the solution implementation defines this operation as 'receiveDelivery(String, int, int)'. Additionally, the provided Main (template/solution) calls 'acceptSupplyDelivery', so the differing identifier between specification, example call sites, and the solution implementation creates a naming mismatch that will confuse students about which method to implement/use.
issues.suggestedFix: Use a single consistent name for the supply-delivery method across all artifacts. Either rename SealSaloon.receiveDelivery to acceptSupplyDelivery (keeping it static with the same signature) and update the implementation accordingly, or adjust the problem statement and example usage to reference receiveDelivery. Ensure all example call sites (Main) and the UML/specification match the implemented method name.
